title: fix: align ADeMS with published AnomDetect semantics
body:
> Correct the existing ADeMS implementation of AnomDetect with DetUpdate: use raw reconstruction error, keep scoring read-only, support empty or all-zero initial data, and compute shrinkage without squaring extreme singular values. Document initialization, one-instance timesteps, prequential scoring, parameter defaults, and numerical-rank conventions. Retain the public export, shared model registrations, example, API entry, and benchmark registration already present on master.
>
> Paper: Huang and Kasiviswanathan, Streaming Anomaly Detection Using Randomized Matrix Sketching, PVLDB 9(3), 192–203 (2015), Algorithms 1 and 3: https://doi.org/10.14778/2850583.2850593.
>
> Reference search covered the paper, the author's publication page, author/GitHub searches, Papers with Code, CRAN, and PyPI. No authors' implementation was located. Compared with takuti/stream-anomaly-detect, SketchUpdate (MIT per README): https://github.com/takuti/stream-anomaly-detect. No source was copied. On the same unit-length stream, maximum score difference was 3.33e-15. The reference normalizes columns; this change follows the published raw-input equations instead. Other reference differences are documented in the class docstring.
>
> Validation: 2,234 passed, 1 skipped, 1 expected failure in pytest -q; 54 examples passed separately; all 13 detector-specific checks passed. Ruff, formatting, pre-commit, mypy, and the Sphinx build with warnings as errors passed. Synthetic prequential AUROC was 1.0. At 100 features, scoring took 0.0066 ms/instance and fit-score took 0.0701 ms/instance. Extreme-scale checks cover 1e-200 and 1e200.
>
> The CI short benchmark ran ADeMS before and after on all 25 ODDS/drift datasets, at most 2,000 points each. All 22 numerical AUROC changes below come from removing per-instance normalization: both the learned covariance directions and residual magnitudes now depend on input length, as in the paper. Nineteen changes exceed the benchmark's 0.005 tolerance; cardio, letter, and shuttle also changed below that tolerance. No other detector or shared model code changed.
